input.behavior_to_protect: In a diamond hierarchy, collecting marks for the leaf class must include the shared ancestor's marks exactly once, not twice.

available_values.hierarchy: class A: mark='a'; class B(A): pass; class C(A): pass; class D(B, C): pass

description: Write one regression scenario with a diamond hierarchy B(A), C(A), D(B,C); collecting marks for D must include A's marks exactly once, not twice. The scenario must fail a mutant that collects base marks by iterating __bases__ without MRO deduplication.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
